title: Marcos inaugurates P91-million solar irrigation system in Leyte

blocks.text: KANANGA, Leyte — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday inaugurated a P91-million solar-powered irrigation system in this town, a project expected to provide water to 155 hectares of farmland and benefit 66 farmers from two barangays amid the threat of prolonged dry conditions associated with El Niño. Marcos assured farmers that the national government would continue assisting the agriculture sector as the country prepares for El Niño’s possible impact on crop production and farmers’ incomes. “You can be assured that your government is doing everything possible to prepare for the expected severe El Niño and the possibility of a longer dry […]...
